name: Insurtech and fintech
description: Techlio builds compliance-sensitive platforms for insurance and financial workflows: agreement engines, multi-party portals, audit trails and automated tracking.
h1: Platforms for money and insurance workflows, *with the audit trail built in.*
answer: Techlio builds software for financial and insurance workflows where every step has to be recorded. For Fund My Deductible we built a secure three-sided platform that connects contractors, sales teams and homeowners with automated agreements, income tracking and full audit trails. Contractors report closing twice as many deals, and a homeowner can be set up in five minutes.
problems: A legally complex workflow run on spreadsheets, email and paper agreements
Several parties who each need their own view of the same transaction
Records that have to stand up to a later review
Onboarding that loses customers because it takes too long

faqs.question: Can you build software for a workflow that has no existing product?
faqs.answer: Yes. Fund My Deductible had no dedicated software for its workflow. We mapped the process with the client and their legal requirements, then built the agreement engine and portals around it.

faqs.question: How do you approach compliance?
faqs.answer: You and your legal advisers define the rules; we build them into the system as required steps, permissions and audit trails so the software enforces them. We do not give legal or regulatory advice.

faqs.question: How long does a platform like this take?
faqs.answer: Fund My Deductible was a fixed-scope build delivered in seven months. Your timeline depends on scope, which we set out after a scoping call.
